x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

Adviesaanvraag.title: Adviesaanvraag
Adviesaanvraag.description: A formal advisory-opinion request (adviesaanvraag) from a deciding body to an external advisory body: jongerenraad, adviesraad sociaal domein, cliëntenraad, modelled as universal GovernanceBody objects (ADR-006, never a parallel schema). It registers who asks whom, the question posed, the linked decision/agenda item/advisory stage, the requested-by date, and the accountability tail (verantwoording) when the final besluit deviates from the advies strekking. It is NOT a Decision subtype and NOT a WOR ConsultationRequest (works-council-consultation, statutory employee participation); its vocabulary is deliberately mirrored where sensible but the objects are separate (design D1). In-route advice stages keep using decision-methods method=advice (actor sets advised/deferred directly); this schema is the request/response/accountability wrapper around such a stage (via advisoryStage) or the out-of-route stand-alone case. The Advies response is a separate first-class artifact (schema advies) authored by the advisory body's secretary, not response fields on this object (design D1). CONSTRAINT (DEFERRED): mandatory-verantwoording-on-deviation is a cross-object conditional requirement (Decision outcome × Advies.strekking × presence of motivering) that the lifecycle dialect cannot express; it is enforced by the imperative fail-closed AdviceAccountabilityGuard in the decision status-transition path, that guard, the additive Decision verantwoording fields, and the bodyType enum extension are the imperative/base-edit tail of this change and are NOT part of this declarative fragment.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-AOW-002). Canonical dialect verbatim from the Decision schema (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'states'-only/'default'). verzonden → in-behandeling → advies-uitgebracht → verantwoord → afgerond, with the conform shortcut advies-uitgebracht → afgerond (no verantwoording needed) and niet-uitgebracht reachable from verzonden and in-behandeling (advisory body declines / request withdrawn / requested-by date lapses without advies). afgerond and niet-uitgebracht are terminal. The app does NOT implement an imperative state machine for this lifecycle; the REQ-AOW-005 guard blocks a Decision transition, it never drives this Adviesaanvraag lifecycle.

adviesaanvraagVerantwoord._note: Deviating-besluit-verantwoord notification to the advisory body's members (REQ-AOW-005). Event-shaped 'updated' trigger firing on the transition to 'verantwoord' where the verantwoordingText is written. LIMITATION: the notification dialect has no recipient kind that targets the advisoryBody's resolved Membership set directly; object-acl(read) + the decidesk-members group is the closest declarative approximation — verify against OR's notification rule engine at import; never an imperative dispatch path (notification-dialect gate).

adviesaanvraagRappelBeforeDeadline._note: Pre-deadline rappel (REQ-AOW-006). intervalSec 1209600 (~14 days) is PROVISIONAL (design open question — griffie-configurable tuning deferred). Filter targets non-terminal, pre-advies lifecycle only. Same window-semantics caveat as the toezeggingen-register rappels: the 'requestedByDate within window' vs 'past requestedByDate' distinction is carried by the scheduled engine's window interpretation, not expressible in this filter DSL — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets these two triggers as before/after-deadline rappels during live import. No bespoke reminder BackgroundJob.

subject.en: Reminder: advice deadline passed without advice — {{subject}}

adviesaanvraagRappelOverdue._note: Overdue rappel (REQ-AOW-006). intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL. Filters non-terminal, pre-advies lifecycle so no notification fires for advies-uitgebracht/verantwoord/afgerond/niet-uitgebracht. Same window-semantics caveat as adviesaanvraagRappelBeforeDeadline. Recipients approximate 'advisory body + griffie' via object-acl (read) + decidesk-members group, because no recipient kind targets the advisoryBody GovernanceBody reference directly.

subject.title: Subject
subject.description: Subject / onderwerp of the advisory-opinion trajectory. Required.

question.title: Question
question.description: The adviesvraag posed to the advisory body (schema:AskAction). Required.
question.example: Sluit de nota aan bij de woonbehoeften van jongeren van 18–27 jaar?

requestingBody.title: Requesting body
requestingBody.description: Reference to the deciding GovernanceBody that asks for the advice (the requester). Required.

advisoryBody.title: Advisory body
advisoryBody.description: Reference to the external advisory GovernanceBody being consulted (jongerenraad / adviesraad sociaal domein / cliëntenraad). Advisory bodies are universal GovernanceBody objects with bodyType advisory-body, never a parallel schema (ADR-006). Required.

sentDate.title: Sent date
sentDate.description: Date the adviesaanvraag was sent to the advisory body. Required.

requestedByDate.title: Requested-by date
requestedByDate.description: Date by which the advice is requested (not a statutory term). Optional; drives the declarative deadline rappels and the overdue workload view. A lapsed date is a reason for the griffie to set niet-uitgebracht: a human decision, never automation (design D5).

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Trajectory status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): verzonden → in-behandeling → advies-uitgebracht → verantwoord → afgerond, with the conform shortcut advies-uitgebracht → afgerond and niet-uitgebracht reachable from verzonden/in-behandeling. afgerond and niet-uitgebracht are terminal.

relatedDecision.title: Related decision
relatedDecision.description: Optional reference to the Decision this advice prepares. When set and a linked Advies deviates from the decision outcome, the DEFERRED AdviceAccountabilityGuard (imperative, not in this fragment) blocks the completing transition until a verantwoording is recorded. Empty for the out-of-route case.

advisoryStage.title: Advisory stage
advisoryStage.description: Optional reference to an in-route advisory DecisionStage (method=advice). When set, the stage actor sets the advised/deferred outcome directly via existing decision-methods semantics (no new derivation mechanism); this aanvraag only adds the request metadata, the Advies artifact and the verantwoording the stage does not model. Empty for the out-of-route stand-alone case.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Optional reference to the AgendaItem the advice relates to. Raadscommissie advies on plenary agenda items remains owned by commissievergaderingen and is NOT registered through this capability.

accountabilityText.title: Verantwoording
accountabilityText.description: Motivering recorded when the final besluit deviates from the advies strekking. Written alongside the transition to verantwoord. The same motivering also lands on the Decision's own verantwoording fields (the DEFERRED additive base-register edit) so the besluit record is self-contained for archiving (design D4). Optional; required only when a deviating decision is completed, enforced by the DEFERRED guard, not by this schema.
accountabilityText.example: De raad kiest locatie B in afwijking van het advies (locatie A) vanwege geluidsnormen.

accountabilityDate.title: Verantwoording date
accountabilityDate.description: Date the verantwoording motivering was recorded. Optional; set alongside verantwoordingText on the transition to verantwoord.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the live adviesaanvraag is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Because the predicate sits on the live object, a verantwoording recorded after publication is publicly visible without republication (design D3). Publish is an explicit staff action; this schema carries no internal-only fields by construction, so the whole object is publishable.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the aanvraag is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.

Advies.title: Advies
Advies.description: The advisory body's formal response artifact (schema:Recommendation) to an Adviesaanvraag: the strekking (positief / positief-met-kanttekeningen / negatief / geen-advies), a summary, the advies date, the recording secretary, and the optional response document (attached via the Files leaf). It is a SEPARATE first-class object, not response fields on the Adviesaanvraag, because it has its own recording authority (the advisory body's secretary, not the requesting griffie), its own publication moment, and its own strekking that the DEFERRED AdviceAccountabilityGuard evaluates (design D1; mirrors the commissievergaderingen CommissieAdvies precedent). Recording an Advies accompanies the Adviesaanvraag transition to advies-uitgebracht. CONSTRAINT (design D4): this schema carries ONLY publishable fields by construction (no internal-only/confidential-remarks property), the whole live object is exposed through the public-group authorization.read rule when publicationDate <= $now, so adding any non-public property requires revisiting the public-predicate design.

adviesUitgebracht._note: Advies-recorded notification (REQ-AOW-003). Event-shaped 'created' trigger firing when the advisory body's secretary records the Advies, which accompanies the aanvraag transition to advies-uitgebracht. Declarative only; never an imperative dispatch path (notification-dialect gate).

adviceRequest.title: Advisory request
adviceRequest.description: Reference to the Adviesaanvraag this advice answers (many-to-one; an aanvraag can in principle carry more than one advies). Required.

tenor.title: Strekking
tenor.description: The advice's overall thrust. Deviation from the decision outcome is sign-only (design D4): positief / positief-met-kanttekeningen with a rejected outcome, or negatief with an adopted outcome, triggers the DEFERRED verantwoording guard; geen-advies never blocks. Required.

summary.title: Summary
summary.example: De adviesraad adviseert positief, mits de continuïteit van lopende ondersteuning wordt geborgd.

adviceDate.title: Advice date
adviceDate.description: Date the advice was issued. Required.

recordedBy.title: Recorded by
recordedBy.description: Reference to the Person (the advisory body's secretary) who records the advice. The recording authority is the advisory body, not the requesting griffie (design D1). Required.

adviceDocument.title: Advice document
adviceDocument.description: Optional reference to the response document (the advies PDF), attached via the Files leaf / DigitalDocument relation.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the live advies is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). The advies publishes independently of its aanvraag. Publish is an explicit staff action.

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the advies is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.
